ننخدع (form VII)
# نَنْخَدِعُ (nanḵadiʕu) /nan.xa.di.ʕu/: first-person plural non-past active indicative of اِنْخَدَعَ (inḵadaʕa)
# نَنْخَدِعَ (nanḵadiʕa) /nan.xa.di.ʕa/: first-person plural non-past active subjunctive of اِنْخَدَعَ (inḵadaʕa)
# نَنْخَدِعْ (nanḵadiʕ) /nan.xa.diʕ/: first-person plural non-past active jussive of اِنْخَدَعَ (inḵadaʕa)
